title: ThinkLife multi-agent platform architecture
summary: System think.multi_agent_platform: original narrative, linked evidence and 1 accomplishment(s).
body:
## ThinkLife multi-agent platform architecture

- Contributed to platform architecture supporting parallel development of specialized agents.
- The platform covered healing, onboarding, FAQ, and storytelling use cases.
- Zoe was one part of this broader architecture.
- Storytelling, FAQ, and onboarding agents were under construction alongside Zoe.

Output and impact:

- Established a structure that could support several specialized agents rather than one isolated chatbot.
- Separated agent responsibilities across distinct use cases.
- Moved Zoe to mental-health board review with the core engineering and safety flow implemented.

Maintainability evidence:

- Specialized responsibilities reduce the need for one unbounded agent to handle every task.
- A shared platform direction supports parallel development without presenting unfinished agents as released products.
